✍️ Gaming Industry Trends & Market Insights

The End of Physical Discs: Challenges of the 'Fully Digital Era' Accelerated by Sony 📀

Where is the 'joy of ownership' we used to feel holding physical game boxes disappearing to? 🤔
Sony's declaration to end physical disc production signifies a fundamental shift in the gaming industry's landscape, going far beyond simple cost reduction.
Sony officially announced the background behind discontinuing physical game disc production, putting an end to the package-centric platform structure that sustained the console market. This clearly demonstrates the global market trend reshaping around digital distribution, much like the mobile expansion of The Division series and the surge of live-service games. 📦➡️📱

These changes directly impact consumers' gaming consumption structures and psychology. Gamers are now entering an era where they no longer 'permanently own' games but rather 'lease access rights,' facing a stagnant used-game market along with platform operators' monopolistic price control. 📉💳

While the transition to a digital ecosystem maximizes efficiency for developers and publishers, it will serve as a double-edged sword that restricts consumers' actual ownership and threatens the historical preservation value of digital games. ⚖️

In a future where disc slots vanish and only service convenience remains, it is time for gamers and the industry to ask themselves if they are prepared to overcome the side effects of the 'digital-only' era. ❓
— Dr. K
